invariant: The ordered registered command language decides whether each complete command is syntactically admissible. No candidate produces a syntax error; a registered command whose execution is not implemented is separately observable residue, not a syntax error and not silent support.
causal_divergence: Rust handler fallthrough sets unconsumed but parse_sequence returns a diagram. Several permissive prefix handlers also consume lines outside Java command grammar. Java PSystemCommandFactory rejects when getCandidate returns null, after complete multiline and registered-order matching.
planned_change: Record the complete registered grammar and map handlers. Add a source-derived admission/consumption layer in sequence.rs, including multiline boundaries, Pattern2 classes and FoxSignature preconditions. Keep recognized unsupported commands nonfatal with class/source diagnostics; propagate absence of any command as ParseError. Validate both previously consumed and unconsumed lines, without changing global factory dispatch.
